verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS cap-table platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API: every cited capability (share issuance, vesting, reports, round modeling, e-signing) is described as a UI or support-article workflow. The llms.txt probe only describes the site and is not a programmatic interface, and spreadsheet import and white-glove migration are not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
